entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-03
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • C# completion list omits parameters in primary constructor when the parameter is used as an argument to the base class #81008
  • Base type for enums is neither properly autocompleted nor classified when declaration ends in semicolon #81007
  • Expose 'With-Element' information in ICollectionExpressionOperation #80998
  • C# and VB CodeLens windows show "Unknown" instead of the text of the reference #80995
  • Build task integration tests started failing #80991
    18.3
  • Stackoverflow in `BindNonGenericSimpleNamespaceOrTypeOrAliasSymbol` in C# extension #80987
    18.3

Closed

  • Better QuickInfo for "this" and "base" in combination with `=>` operator #40879
  • `allows ref struct` generic can't be tested with `is` #73918
    Backlog
  • CS0012 emitted for internal types #80921
    18.3
  • Members, used only in DebuggerDisplay for "Name" or "Type" reported as unused #71523
    Backlog
  • Roslyn Crash #72327
    Backlog
  • Huge memory usage and slow analyzers #71949
    Backlog
  • Gracefully handle misplaced `!` token after type names #71723
    Backlog
  • Expander button in Rename adornment is not visible in Dark theme #71651
    18.0

    Backlog
  • Persist messages from running code analysis #71313

  • Unexpected ref safety error in an assignment #79054

  • A test gap in `GetValEscape` method #73549
    18.3
